reviews.author: ParagC
reviews.title: Good Quality and Super Fast Installation
reviews.body: I'm really impressed by the communication and automation offered by Urban Company. As soon as you place order on Amazon, if you have same number registered with UC, they will inform you about Installation Schedule and you can re schedule it if required. The installation was hassle free. Water Quality is good and best part I loved about this Water filter is that it can be used as Table Top and due to mechanical switch you can get water even if Electricity is off. You will get Free Meter to check Water Hardness. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: yarraguntla bhargav
reviews.title: EXCELLENT WATER PURIFIER
reviews.body: Worth purchasing, I have been using since 1 week, I have tested water with tds meter and TDS level is in between 40 to 60 ppm, I have also tested PH level of water with testing drops and result is always alkaline. Water doesn't have any smell and tastes good compared to normal mineral water. I recommend to purchase.
